command:
set -eu; ROOT="$HOME/omega-bootstrap"; git -C "$ROOT/oMEGA" fetch origin main; git -C "$ROOT/oMEGA" checkout main; git -C "$ROOT/oMEGA" merge --ff-only origin/main; SHA=$(git -C "$ROOT/oMEGA" rev-parse HEAD); git -C "$ROOT/carrier" fetch origin omega-vps-deploy; git -C "$ROOT/carrier" checkout -B omega-vps-deploy origin/omega-vps-deploy; DEST="$ROOT/carrier/omega_deploy/$SHA"; mkdir -p "$DEST"; if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then rsync -a --exclude=.git "$ROOT/oMEGA/" "$DEST/"; else cp -a "$ROOT/oMEGA/." "$DEST/"; fi; python3 - <<PY
import json,pathlib,datetime
root=pathlib.Path('$ROOT/carrier/omega_deploy'); sha='$SHA'
p={'schema':'OMEGA_VPS_DEPLOY_CARRIER/v1','omega_repo':'gschaidergabriel/oMEGA','omega_head':sha,'source_machine_id':'ai-core-node','source_owner':'gabriel','created_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'path':'omega_deploy/'+sha}
(root/'LATEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
cd "$ROOT/carrier"; git add "omega_deploy/$SHA" omega_deploy/LATEST.json; if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo CARRIER_ALREADY_CURRENT; else git commit -m "omega: publish immutable VPS deployment carrier $SHA"; git push origin HEAD:omega-vps-deploy; fi; echo OMEGA_HEAD=$SHA
